about: We the SAP HR are a fast-growing, dependable, and a promising HR consultancy service provider; we’ve got the experience of 19 years and have the elegant Group of recruitment Specialists with expertise and profound knowledge of the recruitment, staffing, assessment & selection services for different countries mainly, i.e., India, Nepal, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Philippines, etc.

We at SAP HR Consultancy has a well- experienced team of 12 recruiters & we work hardly in ensuring that our people have the knowledge, skills & resources to provide service over & above expectation & we arealways looking for people with motivation, drive & zest to join our thriving enterprise.
